config.description: Skip-class SELF-condition sweep — SELF conditions (res-shred/dmg/etc.) the port SKIPPED because no golden toggles them (the 58k DAMAGE goldens are blind to them; surfaced by tools/oracle/diff-parity.mjs). The port systematically modelled the `party.*` teammate mirror but skipped the SELF version. Each rep bakes the char's SELF toggle via mergeCharSettings (a char-axis setting, infusionItems' diluc_dawn channel) so her engine applies the self condition to EVERY one of the char's own damage features; dump-oracle branches on cfg.partyItems and writes one <slug>.json per rep via engine.computeParty. zhongli-jade-shield: Zhongli's own Jade Shield (raw Zhongli.js:316-331, a C0 ConditionBoolean, NO ascension/cons gate) grants −20 enemy RES to all 7 elements + physical, buffing every Zhongli damage feature. The port modelled party.zhongli_jade_shield (the teammate mirror, Zhongli.js:447-463) but SKIPPED the SELF version → every Zhongli damage triple undershot by the res-shred at zhongli_jade_shield:true. GREEN once the SELF condition is ported into zhongli.ts (conditions[]). selfBuffsBurndown threads the SAME toggle into buildStats + compileCharacter and asserts the buffed triples. To add the next char: one item in selfBuffsItems + one SETTINGS_BY_SLUG row + re-dump (`node tools/oracle/dump-oracle.mjs self-buffs`).
